title: Motor States V2.0
description: Enumerates motor states for CAV Motion Actuation.

oneOf.description: Nominal operation; within limits and meeting requested setpoints.
Wheel/motor spinning with insufficient tractive force (slip detected).
Motor enabled but producing negligible torque/velocity.
Transient state ramping from idle to active.
Transient state ramping down toward idle/off.
Output limited due to temperature thresholds (thermal derating).
Output limited due to DC bus/line voltage constraints.
Output limited to protect current limits or driver ratings.
Controller saturated; cannot increase output to meet setpoint.
Fault raised due to exceeding thermal protection thresholds.
Fault raised due to exceeding current protection thresholds.
Fault raised due to DC bus/line undervoltage.
Fault in encoder, resolver, temperature, or current sensors.
Loss or corruption of communication with controller/drive.
In calibration/zeroing procedure; output may be constrained.
Motor/controller powered down or administratively disabled.
Emergency stop engaged; torque/drive disabled by safety logic.
